summary_note: Six claims separate exact wording, sense, provenance, and unproved derivation.

claims.statement: The Sunny South prints woozy at a line end followed by doozy ducky in exaggerated baby talk on June 1, 1901.
claims.rationale: Preserve the distinction between what the dated sources show and what the sources leave open.

evidence_boundary.establishes: The Sunny South prints woozy at a line end followed by doozy ducky in exaggerated baby talk on June 1, 1901.
evidence_boundary.does_not_establish: It does not establish a pre-1903 ordinary adjective or a pre-1916 count noun.
evidence_boundary.remaining_uncertainty: Whether the author adapted existing slang or invented the rhyme is unknown.

limitations: It does not establish a pre-1903 ordinary adjective or a pre-1916 count noun.
